external_comparison.reason: no local competitor with an EQUIVALENT model (capability-bound in-process WASM + forced process isolation + signed execution attestation). wasmer/wasm3 (coremark_wasi.py) are engine-context columns, not equal-security competitors. gVisor/hardened-docker are different security boundaries — comparing them as like-for-like would be an unfair claim.

docker_cold_start.classification: Docker/gVisor/hardened-container numbers already in the repo (gvisor_docker_probe.py, hardened_docker_probe.py, BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md) are CONTAINER cold-start vs WASM warm runs. Different start condition AND different security model.
docker_cold_start.rule: no single 'Nx faster' factor may be claimed across those boundaries; only like-for-like (same workload, same start condition, same active security boundary) comparisons are valid — which the pilot VM will provide, not the current lab host.
